The 119 checked tasks are every \texttt{tasks/**/*.yaml} file carrying an

In all 11 trajectories the argument sent by the model is
\texttt{convert\_temperature(\{"value":\ 15,\allowbreak\ "from\_unit":\ "celsius",\allowbreak\ "to\_unit":\ "fahrenheit"\})};
no other argument occurs. Since $15.0\,^{\circ}$C is itself absent from the
environment data, the value 15 does not come from the input either.
